glossary.definition: (1) "Automated external defibrillation" means the process of applying a specialized defibrillator to a person in cardiac arrest, allowing the defibrillator to interpret the cardiac rhythm, and, if appropriate, delivering an electrical shock to the heart to allow it to resume effective electrical activity.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.235 - Immunity of person involved with providing automated external defibrillation.
